contracts.boundary: Scan the actual push before-to-after history and first-parent merge changes, failing closed on invalid event boundaries and merge enumeration errors; preserve PR and manual scanning. Historical fixture findings are excluded only by exact commit, path, rule and line fingerprints.
contracts.assertions: Executable Gitleaks controls detect side-branch and merge-only secrets, exclude pre-base and deleted content, and require merge enumeration errors to propagate. The real 9df98a3-to-982a4ce push range scanned cleanly. A Node witness checks action pins. The pinned integration history scan is clean with 19 verified synthetic historical fingerprints, while removing the ignore file or copying a fixture value into a new commit is detected.

boundaryTest.exception: The Gitleaks boundary controls run directly in the secrets workflow using the pinned scanner, rather than as Node test events.

invariant.name: pins every external action reference to a full commit SHA

fault.exception: The executable boundary controls inject a git rev-list failure and require its nonzero exit to propagate.

contracts.boundary: Select exactly one of two fixed-path declarations by trusted event base, use the same selection for acceptance witnesses and final validation, and cover any changed non-selected declaration.
contracts.assertions: Selection rejects missing or ambiguous matching bases and stale push events; exact diff coverage includes a changed non-selected manifest. Local acceptance retains normal witness selection.

boundaryTest.name: uses one base-selected artifact for acceptance witnesses and exact preflight coverage

invariant.name: main release and later ordinary pushes select declarations by their own event.before

fault.name: fault control: selecting HEAD parent instead of event.before turns push base RED
